name: Thaumaturgy (Path of the Focused Mind) — 2 Intermediate — One-Tracked Mind

system.description: By winning a Mental Challenge and speaking to a target for one action, the thaumaturge fixates the subject on a single action or thought, causing him to ignore all distractions. In combat, the target may perform no other actions for its remainder; outside combat, he continues his prior activity for one scene. The target gains an extra Trait toward challenges pursuing that fixation and genuinely believes the obsession was his own idea.
system.duration: One scene or remainder of combat
